conceptBreakdown.codeSnippet:
FAMILY SOLANACEAE PROFILE
                                     │
         ┌───────────────────────────┼───────────────────────────┐
         ▼                           ▼                           ▼
  VEGETATIVE TRAITS           FLORAL ARCHITECTURE          DIAGNOSTIC GYNOECIUM
 ├── Herbaceous / Shrubs     ├── \oplus \ \succ Actinomorphic   ├── Bicarpellary Syncarpous
 ├── Underground Tubers      ├── \mathbf{K}_{(5)} Persistent Valvate├── Obliquely Placed Ovary (45°)
 └── Exstipulate Alternate   ├── \overbrace{\mathbf{C}_{(5)} \ \mathbf{A}_5} Epipetalous  └── Swollen Axile Placenta
conceptBreakdown.content:
Family Solanaceae (commonly called the Nightshade Family) is a large, economically vital family of dicotyledons distributed across tropical, subtropical, and temperate zones.

### Diagnostic Characters
• **Vegetative**: Mostly herbs or shrubs; stem erect with underground tubers in *Solanum tuberosum*; leaves alternate, simple, exstipulate with reticulate venation.
• **Calyx**: Sepals 5, gamosepalous ($\mathbf{K}_{(5)}$), persistent on the fruit (*Physalis*, *Brinjal*), valvate aestivation.
• **Corolla**: Petals 5, gamopetalous ($\mathbf{C}_{(5)}$), valvate aestivation.
• **Androecium**: Stamens 5, epipetalous ($\overbrace{\mathbf{C}_{(5)} \mathbf{A}_5}$), polyandrous, alternating with petals.
• **Gynoecium**: Bicarpellary, syncarpous ($\mathbf{\underline{G}}_{(2)}$); Ovary Superior; **Obliquely Placed** (posterior carpel shifted $45^\circ$ to the right); bilocular, becoming tetralocular due to a false septum; Placentation **Axile with highly swollen placenta** bearing numerous ovules.
• **Fruit & Seed**: Berry (*Tomato*, *Brinjal*, *Chilli*) or Capsule (*Datura*); seeds numerous, endospermic.

conceptBreakdown.title: 8.2 Economic Importance Matrix of Solanaceae
conceptBreakdown.content:
| Economic Category | Scientific Name | Common Name | Economic Utility / Active Alkaloids |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Food Plants** | *Solanum tuberosum* | Potato | Starch-rich underground stem tubers |
| | *Lycopersicon esculentum* | Tomato | Edible berry rich in lycopene and vitamin C |
| | *Solanum melongena* | Brinjal / Eggplant | Edible berry vegetable |
| **Spices** | *Capsicum annuum* | Chilli / Red Pepper | Pungent spice containing **capsaicin** |
| **Medicinal Plants** | *Withania somnifera* | Ashwagandha | Adaptogenic tonic containing **withanolides** |
| | *Atropa belladonna* | Deadly Nightshade | Source of anticholinergic drug **Atropine** (pupil dilator) |
| | *Datura stramonium* | Datura / Thornapple | Source of **Scopolamine / Hyoscyamine** |
| **Fumigatory** | *Nicotiana tabacum* | Tobacco | Leaves processed for smoking/chewing; contains **Nicotine** |
| **Ornamentals** | *Petunia hybrida* | Petunia | Popular garden ornamental flower |
| | *Cestrum nocturnum* | Night-blooming Jasmine | Fragrant ornamental flowering shrub |
